vision.title: Minimalist weddings with an editorial soul
vision.description: We hand-pick locations, design atmospheres and coordinate every gesture so that beauty flows effortlessly.

points.one: A limited number of 12 weddings per year.
points.three: Complete transparency in budget and timelines.

about.title: Hi! It's Anna,
about.body: Behind every wedding there is a unique story. Mine is about transforming emotions into experiences meant to be remembered forever. Are you ready for all the magic that’s about to unfold?
about.imageAlt: Photo of the team smiling together in the studio

planning.title: Wedding Planning
planning.description: Designing timelines, budgets and coordinating vendors so everything happens smoothly.

artDirection.title: Art Direction
artDirection.description: Visual concept, palette, florals and styling to create a coherent, memorable look.

production.title: Production & Logistics
production.description: Technical setup, on-site supervision and vendor coordination for a flawless day.

coordination.title: Day Coordination
coordination.description: Timing, team management and on-the-day problem solving so you only enjoy the moment.

destination.title: Destination Weddings
destination.description: Full organisation for weddings abroad: travel, accommodation and local logistics.

honeymoon.title: Honeymoon
honeymoon.description: Tailored experiences and bookings to turn your trip into an unforgettable extension of the celebration.
